verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the Shop Flavours CTA is pushed into the subhead line, about 12px from the end of 'one long season.', so it reads as an inline afterthought and no longer anchors the right side as it does in the original. The decorative circles now float fully inside the canvas instead of bleeding off its edges, and the lower-right circle sits awkwardly behind the CTA's corner. There is dead space at the right of the flavour-pill row, and the legal line is still tiny.
